row.note: UBSan reports index 16 out of bounds for guint8[16] without a READ/WRITE line, so the sink is 119, though the diff shows the access is a write to lchId[num_items-1]. SetImageExtent allocates the 1x1 property_image without initialising its pixels; the fix adds SetImageBackgroundColor in InterpretImageProperties. The fx evaluation then reads the uninitialised pixel. The AcquireAlignedMemory origin is generic allocation, not where the missing write belongs.

The crash is a READ SEGV at 0x8 in Py_TYPE within _PyCode_ConstantKey, a NULL dereference (476), but no listed site is in that function. The fix corrects how inline_comprehension classifies __class__ in class scope, a logic error with no matching vocabulary cue, and get_localsplus_counts may only be on the path that produces the NULL.

Heap-use-after-free READ, so by convention source 416 and sink 125. The read_xref loop wrongly treats object -1 as an earlier generation of itself and calls removeObject on it, which frees the node of the live iterator that the loop then reads; the fix's id > 0 check is in this same function, and the libc++ delete frame (site 2) only records the free.

The pause set policy array was sized to ETHTOOL_A_PAUSE_TX, so the parsed attribute table was too small and pause_parse_request read tb[ETHTOOL_A_PAUSE_STATS_SRC] past its end. The fix enlarges the policy and rejects that attribute, but the defect sits in a global policy definition rather than in any function, so source_site is unclear.
